tools.name: get_rule
tools.description: Read one stored EU e-invoice rule by id. Returns the stored statement, context, test, plain reading, fix, and source URL. Does not check an invoice.

tools.name: search_rules
tools.description: Find stored rules by words, a BT code, or a group. Each hit returns the stored statement, plain reading, fix, and source URL. At most 100 hits. Does not check an invoice.

tools.name: explain_error
tools.description: Read a stored rule named in a rule id or a validator message. Returns the stored statement, plain reading, fix, and source URL when a stored rule matches. Does not check an invoice.

tools.name: check_invoice
tools.description: Read a UBL Invoice XML slice of at most 60000 characters. Returns the business terms that slice writes, the field-map gaps, and one stored note when BR-DE-15 finds no non-empty buyer reference (BT-10). evaluation is false: no Schematron runs. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_rule, search_rules, explain_error, check_invoice · Private data: check_invoice · Public sink: check_invoice.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_rule, search_rules, explain_error, check_invoice · Private data: check_invoice · Public sink: check_invoice

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
